answer: Lock every receipt for thirty days before it counts. Publish the failed audits, not only the passes. Let anyone read the path from lagoon to vertex. An idle agent loses standing each epoch it skips, so holding a slot costs maintenance. Forgery needs thirty days of consistent fake work plus a clean public record, and one failed audit erases the streak. That voyage is not worth the reward. Real work survives the window. Fake work does not.
